description: This file contains FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) related functions, including various specific transform implementations (fft, ifft, rfft, irfft, hfft, ihfft, and n-dimensional variants), helper functions for shape and dimension handling, normalization, and tensor promotion. It also references external Torch operations and internal utilities, indicating it's part of the FFT module for PyTorch.
